name: Exp_Laguerre_ADX
summary: This EA trades based on the Laguerre_ADX custom indicator, opening buy positions when the Up line crosses above the Dn line and sell positions when the Dn line crosses above the Up line. It uses a crossover signal on a specified timeframe with configurable money management, stop loss, and take profit levels.
summary_zh: 该EA基于Laguerre_ADX自定义指标进行交易，当Up线上穿Dn线时开多仓，当Dn线上穿Up线时开空仓。它在指定时间周期上使用交叉信号，并配置了资金管理、止损和止盈参数。
strategy_analysis: 该EA使用Laguerre_ADX指标的趋势跟踪策略，Laguerre_ADX是对传统ADX指标的拉盖尔滤波改进版本，通过gamma参数控制平滑度。入场条件为：当Up[1]>Dn[1]（当前柱Up线高于Dn线）且前一柱Up[0]<Dn[0]（Up线从下方穿越Dn线）时开多仓；反之当Up[1]<Dn[1]且Up[0]>Dn[0]时开空仓。出场条件通过交叉反向信号触发平仓，同时设置了固定的止损1000点和止盈2000点。仓位管理采用MM参数控制资金比例，默认0.1，支持手数模式和保证金模式两种资金管理方式。EA在每个新K线到来时计算信号，使用IsNewBar机制避免重复交易，SignalBar参数允许选择回溯柱数进行信号确认。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA employs a trend-following strategy using the Laguerre_ADX indicator, which is a Laguerre-filtered improvement over the traditional ADX indicator, with the gamma parameter controlling the smoothing level. Entry conditions: a buy position opens when Up[1]>Dn[1] (current bar Up line above Dn line) and Up[0]<Dn[0] (Up line crossed from below), while a sell position opens when Up[1]<Dn[1] and Up[0]>Dn[0]. Exit conditions are triggered by the reverse crossover signal closing the opposing position, combined with a fixed stop loss of 1000 points and take profit of 2000 points. Position sizing uses the MM parameter to control the capital ratio with a default of 0.1, supporting both lot mode and margin mode for money management. The EA calculates signals on each new bar arrival using the IsNewBar mechanism to prevent duplicate trades, and the SignalBar parameter allows selecting a lookback bar for signal confirmation. The crossover logic essentially detects trend direction changes in the Laguerre-filtered ADX lines.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 资金管理比例，控制下单手数
parameters.description_en: Money management parameter; negative value for risk percentage mode

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 手数计算模式：手数模式或保证金模式
parameters.description_en: Lot calculation mode: fixed lots or margin mode

parameters.name: gamma
parameters.description: 拉盖尔滤波器平滑系数

pros: 使用拉盖尔滤波器改进ADX指标，信号更平滑、减少假信号
新K线机制避免同一K线内重复开仓，逻辑严谨
支持灵活的资金管理方式（手数模式和保证金模式）
买卖方向开关独立控制，可以只做多或只做空
止损止盈参数完整，风险可控
pros_en: Uses Laguerre filter to improve the ADX indicator, providing smoother signals with fewer false triggers
New bar mechanism prevents duplicate trade entries within the same bar, ensuring logical rigor
Supports flexible money management with both lot mode and margin mode
Independent buy/sell direction switches allow trading only long or only short
Complete stop loss and take profit parameters provide controllable risk
cons: 固定止损止盈不适应不同市场波动率环境
缺少点差过滤，在高点差环境下可能产生不利入场
无仓位检查逻辑，可能重复开仓
依赖自定义指标Laguerre_ADX，指标文件缺失则EA无法运行
止损1000点止盈2000点的比例2:1虽然有利但止损点数偏大
cons_en: Fixed stop loss and take profit do not adapt to varying market volatility environments
No spread filter, potentially entering at unfavorable prices in high-spread conditions
No existing position check before opening new trades, potentially leading to duplicate positions
Depends on the custom Laguerre_ADX indicator file; EA fails if the indicator is missing
The 1000-point SL and 2000-point TP ratio of 2:1 is favorable but the stop loss size is quite large
improvements: 添加仓位检查逻辑，避免同方向重复开仓
加入ATR动态止损止盈，适应市场波动率变化
添加点差过滤器，避免高点差时段入场
improvements_en: Add position check logic to prevent duplicate entries in the same direction
Implement ATR-based dynamic stop loss and take profit to adapt to market volatility changes
Add a spread filter to avoid entering during high-spread periods

risk_points: 缺少现有仓位检查，可能在同方向重复开仓导致过度杠杆
固定止损1000点较大，在极端行情下可能造成显著亏损
无点差过滤和交易时间过滤，可能在不利条件下入场
risk_points_en: No existing position check may cause duplicate entries in the same direction leading to excessive leverage
Fixed 1000-point stop loss is large and can cause significant losses in extreme market conditions
No spread filter or trading session filter may result in entries under unfavorable conditions

It uses a crossover signal on a specified timeframe with configurable money management, stop loss, and take profit levels.
